page_title: SAL 1-2 GEN | Salernitana v Genoa 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Daniele Orsato is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Josep Martinez (Genoa) receives a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Josep Martinez intercepts the ball.
87' Substitution. Kevin Strootman is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
86' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
84' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
83' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) replacing Agustin Martegani.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch for Domagoj Bradaric.
81' The foul by Morten Thorsby (Genoa) was seen by Daniele Orsato who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Salernitana have a free kick.

78' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Genoa earn a free kick.
75' That will be all from Matteo Lovato who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana).
75' It's time for a substitution. Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) comes on in place of Loum Tchaouna.
73' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Guillermo Ochoa has no trouble gathering it.
71' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Alessandro Vogliacco and he is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) was quite harsh and Daniele Orsato didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' It is time for a substitution. Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is on for Toma Basic.
68' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
67' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

62' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the bar and ricochet away. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
61' Salernitana are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
60' Mattia Bani (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Orsato and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
58' 1 - 2 Goal! Guillermo Ochoa gets a hand on the penalty from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), but can't stop it from flying into the middle of the goal.
57' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' It’s a PENALTY to Genoa after the VAR review!
57' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Orsato must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Genoa using VAR. This could be interesting!
56' Surely that's handball by one of the Salernitana players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
54' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

53' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Good work from Salernitana as they win a corner.
53' Simy (Salernitana) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Salernitana earn a corner.
51' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle and it's Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
47' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
47' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Daniele Orsato has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
45+2' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) will deliver the corner kick.
45+1' Daniele Orsato shows a yellow card to Milan Badelj (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

42' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Salernitana will take a corner.
38' The linesman signals that Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
37' Simy (Salernitana) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
36' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
35' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner with a short pass.
35' The referee blows his whistle, Salernitana are awarded a corner kick. Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
34' A brilliant cross into the box finds Mateo Retegui (Genoa), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
32' Simy (Salernitana) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Josep Martinez makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
31' Daniele Orsato couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kevin Strootman (Genoa) and blew his whistle. Salernitana win a free kick.
29' Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Simy, but Josep Martinez displays great awareness to stop him.
29' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Orsato didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
26' The corner from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence.

25' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
23' This shall not pass! Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
20' Djed Spence (Genoa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) serves up a nice cross, but Josep Martinez punches the ball away.
13' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Milan Badelj tees up Mateo Retegui (Genoa) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Guillermo Ochoa.
8' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
7' Genoa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' 1 - 0 Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He fires the ball into the top left corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Orsato.
